capabilities: Analyze jpg, jpeg, png and webp images with vision AI models
Return a keyword list for each analyzed image
Configure AI backends via the AI Providers plugin or built-in Ollama, Gemini and llama.cpp providers
Cache analysis results in JSON files that can be synced between devices
Expose an API for use as a dependency in other plugins
extras: Going forward, new AI backends will be supported through the AI Providers plugin rather than per-service providers in this plugin; new provider requests should go to the AI Providers repository.
problem: Obsidian treats images as opaque files with no way to extract their content as searchable text or keywords.

relations.evidence: The recommended way to configure AI backends (and the future default) is via the AI Providers community plugin
The plugin is integrated with the Obsidian OmniSearch Plugin.
This plugin is heavily inspired by the Obsidian Text Extractor Plugin.

summary: Plugin that analyzes images in the vault with vision-capable AI models (Ollama, Gemini, llama.cpp) and returns a keyword list for each image.
